title: Assisting Victims of Overseas Terrorism Bill 2010

speeches.speaker: George Brandis
speeches.brief: The member moved to introduce a bill to establish a process for assisting victims of overseas terrorist acts. The bill was presented and read a first time.

speeches.speaker: George Brandis
speeches.brief: The speaker moved a bill to create a national scheme providing financial assistance to Australians injured or killed by overseas terrorist acts, estimating a cost of $2.25 million per year based on an average of 30 victims annually.
